rows.From the date of approval of the resolut: Virtuoso Compressors Private Limited (VCPL) was incorporated in FY 2025–26 as a 90% subsidiary of the Company. The primary objective of this transaction is to enable VCPL to establish its operational framework and achieve self- sustainability. As VCPL ramps up its operations, its financial results will be consolidated with those of the Company, driving consolidated revenue growth and creating long-term value appreciation for the shareholders. Both entities belong to the Virtuoso Group; each operates independently with distinct commercial responsibilities. The transactions are designed to harness group synergies, ensure continuity and reliability in the supply of goods and services, and enhance operational efficiency, without compromising independence. Further, the proposed RPTs are undertaken in the ordinary course of business and on an arm’s length basis.
